verdict.rationale: Codegen explicitly supports headless/automated usage via a Python SDK for programmatic agent invocation, a REST API with explicit CI/CD trigger support ('Trigger agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail'), and a CLI for scripted interactions and telemetry — all first-party documented. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of CI usage in the wild and a working OpenAPI spec (probe found 404s), so it's vendor-doc-only evidence.
